title: Medical Device Adverse Event Tracker Input

deviceName.title: Device name
deviceName.description: Free-text search across the device's generic name (e.g. "insulin pump", "pacemaker", "hip implant"). Leave blank to skip device-name filtering.

eventType.title: Event type
eventType.description: Malfunction = device didn't work as intended. Injury = a patient/user was harmed. Death = a death was associated with the device.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back from today to search, by date the report was received by FDA.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of reports to return, most recently received first.
